title: Seat wake-up (webhook push)
description: What the table host POSTs to a seat's daemon when something on the ledger needs that seat. The daemon spools it and never writes back to the ledger: Table Core stays the only writer. The shape follows A2A push notifications: one POST per event, the receiver acknowledges with 2xx, and a body that does not parse is refused.

subscription.description: The id the host returned when this seat registered. Lets a receiver deduplicate a retried delivery.

cursor.description: Ledger seq this wake is about. A seat that has already acked it can drop it silently.

wakes.description: Why this seat is being told. The same entry can carry more than one reason.

entry.description: The ledger entry as this seat may see it. Content is never widened: a direct message reaches only its recipients.
